title: Cloud Security: remittance rails
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for remittance rails.

## Basis

Accepted remittance methods: Accepted remittance methods; string list.

|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | ACH, wire, card |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | ACH, wire, card |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | ACH, wire, card |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | ACH, wire, card |

The listed remittance rails bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
